description: This file contains unit tests for the HpackVarintDecoder class, testing variable-length integer encoding/decoding in HTTP/2 HPACK header compression, including encoding validation and round-trip tests with various prefix and extension byte lengths.

classes.name: HpackVarintRoundTripTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing HPACK variable-length integer encoding/decoding.

methods.name: HiValueOfExtensionBytes
methods.description: Calculates the highest value with a given number of extension bytes and prefix length.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Initial decoding step for the test, starting with a prefix byte.

methods.name: DecodeSeveralWays
methods.description: Validates decoding correctness across different segmentations.

methods.name: EncodeNoRandom
methods.description: Encodes a value with a specified prefix length without adding randomness.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a value with randomness added to the prefix bits.

methods.name: ValidateEncoding
methods.description: Checks that the encoded buffer matches expected encoding properties.

methods.name: EncodeAndDecodeValues
methods.description: Encodes a set of values and verifies round-trip correctness.

methods.name: EncodeAndDecodeValuesInRange
methods.description: Encodes a range of values and verifies correctness.
